pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Orca is the place for working with a fleet of coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ...). Fan a prompt across many agents, each in its own git worktree, and track the results in one place.
This ebuild builds from source against the overlay's dev-util/electron (electron-r1). Orca's electron-builder config runs CI-only verification hooks even for an unpacked build — a glibc 2.31 floor on bundled native binaries (verifyLinuxGlibcFloor) and a set of Assert*/verify* checks aimed at the upstream Ubuntu 20.04 AppImage. A native Gentoo (modern glibc) build cannot satisfy the floor, so those hooks are relaxed by a patch; they are CI guards, not runtime requirements.

use.flag: Fetch the pnpm store at build time (required for a fresh build; no offline mode is implemented).

Build and bundle the native Wayland clipboard helper (orca-wayland-clipboard), a temporary workaround for Electron bug #54645 that only runs on native Wayland. Not used on X11; default off, enable on Wayland sessions.
